crossRefs.note: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness…
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

translations.web: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.
translations.bsb: the man is diseased; he is unclean. The priest must pronounce him unclean because of the infection on his head.
translations.kjv: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
translations.asv: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall surely pronounce him unclean; his plague is in his head.
